response.justification: Bogdan brings a long and varied hands-on engineering career (roughly 15+ years including freelance work) across web, mobile, embedded, and high-throughput backend systems, plus founder experience with an open-source geo-data platform and a track record of teaching and public speaking. However, the role is a director-level individual contributor focused on AI strategy, requiring recognized AI expertise, demonstrated AI products or platforms, and deep cloud fluency to advise strategic customers. His resume shows only recent, limited AI exposure (MCP tooling and agent infrastructure at re:cinq), modest cloud depth (AWS CDK, Kubernetes, Docker), and no evidence of strategic influence, executive-level advisory work, or engineering leadership at the scale implied. The profile reads as a strong senior/staff hands-on builder rather than a principal-level AI strategist.
strengths: Broad 15+ year hands-on engineering career across web, mobile, embedded, and low-latency backend systems
Founder of an open-source geo-data platform with real-world NGO users; entrepreneurial and OSS track record
Strong engineering-craft culture: TDD, CI/CD, plus workshops, courses, and conference talks
concerns: Minimal demonstrated AI/ML expertise — no shipped AI products, research, or advanced AI degree
No evidence of principal/director-level scope, strategy work, or advising strategic customers and partners
Cloud experience appears tactical (AWS CDK, Kubernetes) rather than platform-strategy depth

key_factors.factor: No director-level IC or strategic leadership scope
Long, diverse hands-on engineering tenure and founder experience
